player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ku JoJoJoin, yuol ku board 5x5 ku cel 0-24.
Ku wak yi, yik yin ku cel man, tɛ̈nɛ̈ '[12]'.
YIN AWIN ku bɛ̈n FOUR ku yin ku cel dɔ̈ɔ̈r ku rööu ku rou ku diɔ̈ɔ̈r.
Ku Player {player_id} yin ee '{symbol}'; ku joŋ yi ee '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lɔ̈k ë cäth cï tuɔ̈c acie lɔ në të path.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} acie kë puɔth. Aci dhil tɔ̈u në kaam de 0 ku 24.

game_action.placed: Wär Player {player_id} acë kekë ëmɛ̈i ({symbol}) thïn de cäl {cell}.

outcome.win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï bɛ̈n tiaam!
outcome.draw: Aköl ë yic ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ!
